contract.scope: Frozen-context component intervention, not full-service replay; shadow/cached calls exclude retrieval and cannot be treated as measured per-arm service latency.
limitations: Reused diagnostic inventory, not a fresh holdout.
G bundles current gates with strict handling of baseline finalizer failures; JSON drafting is held out.
S tests the extra selector; full current intent routing and source-priority retrieval are held out.
Q uses shared draft citations, not the E37 selection-only model call. English includes source translation.
Nine unavailable historical contexts remain empty and are retained in outcomes.
Claude judgments are model assessments, not human musical adjudication.

execution.limitation: Per-call component timings with shared caches and offline shadow drafts. Not per-condition service latency; retrieval is excluded.

static_output_audit.policy: Security-only derivation includes the post-run deterministic output screen. Original 10 generated conditions remain unchanged.

judge_batches.retry_policy: Only invalid schema or nonexact quotations retry; first valid verdict retained regardless of quality.
judge_batches.cost_note: Reported accepted CLI responses only; invalid-attempt cost is not included. Not a billing statement.
